clips.text: You step off the kerb — and your shoe stays dry.
clips.image: ACTION/AFTERMATH: a young man with brown hair in a blue hoodie stepping off a rainy city kerb, one shoe hovering over a puddle, the shoe completely dry, rain falling, storm-grey city rain, wet asphalt, slate grey, rain silver, neon reflections in puddles, cinematic, no text
clips.note: FUNNEL: verbatim the long’s a1 line + reuses the long’s a1 visual beat/asset.

clips.text: He takes another step. Still dry. Then another. He crosses the whole puddle, then the whole street, without one splash — while everyone else steps around the water.
clips.image: a young man with brown hair in a blue hoodie crossing a whole rain puddle on dry shoes, then stepping onto the street, rain falling, storm-grey city rain, wet asphalt, slate grey, rain silver, neon reflections in puddles, photorealistic, no text
clips.note: escalation: puddle to street. No numbers, no mechanism names.

clips.text: Look at his feet. Each foot slaps the water faster than you can blink — and the water holds him up, one slap at a time, like the puddle forgot how to be wet.
clips.image: Extreme close-up of a shoe slapping a rain puddle faster than a blink, water bursting sideways, the shoe dry, storm-grey palette, slate grey, rain silver, photorealistic, no text
clips.note: Layer-1 PAYOFF IN SHORT: the dry shoe is real, the slap is blink-fast. No number.

clips.text: Now he crosses a whole river, dry shoes, dry socks, while the crowd on the bridge stares down in the rain. But watch him closely. He never slows down. Not even once.
clips.image: a young man with brown hair in a blue hoodie crossing a whole river on dry shoes, a crowd watching from a bridge above, rain falling, storm-grey palette, slate grey, rain silver, photorealistic, no text
clips.note: escalation: the river. Sets up the Layer-2 question.

clips.text: So why can’t he stop — not for one second?
clips.image: Close-up of a young man with brown hair in a blue hoodie running across water, face set, rain falling, never slowing, storm-grey palette, slate grey, rain silver, photorealistic, no text
clips.note: Layer-2 question: spoken AND flagged for kinetic text. Answered in the long’s a2 (~8s in).

clips.text: The answer is one number — and it changes everything.
clips.image: a young man with brown hair in a blue hoodie running across water toward the camera, rain falling, the river stretching behind him, storm-grey palette, slate grey, rain silver, photorealistic, no text
clips.note: bridge line. Names no number, no mechanism, no Moon.

clips.text: Thirty metres a second, on every single step — and the one pause that sinks you. Full story: tap the video link under my name.
clips.image: Frozen thumbnail frame: protagonist waist-deep and sinking in a puddle, arms out, ripples spreading, one foot still flat on the surface, storm-grey city rain, wet asphalt, slate grey, rain silver, neon reflections in puddles, no text
clips.note: END-CARD VO (~5s, plays over the frozen thumbnail; coordinator owns the thumbnail). Names the withheld mechanism + signpost. NEVER “link in description”.
